properties.description: * WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, 3 to 5 foot surf and dangerous rip currents expected. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 6 AM Wednesday to 11 AM PDT Friday.  * IMPACTS...Flooding of beach parking lots, boardwalks, and roads with only isolated road closures expected. unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

properties.description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida... dangerous surf conditions.

direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.
